id="notes" value="UML entity model: solid lines are associations; multiplicities describe the named roles, not database integrity. Attributes use [0..1] for optional values and [0..*] for lists. {PK}/{UQ} are schema-key constraints. Enforced relations and scalar-ID mappings are listed below; cross-service IDs are not foreign keys.<br>Friendship pair UNIQUE(userOneId,userTwoId); UserBlock PK(blockerId,blockedUserId); UserRole UNIQUE(userId,roleId). Cross-service user references and refresh replacement IDs are not database foreign keys. Multiplicity describes each named role; two-role links do not mean one shared user.<br>role: roleId to id (declared SQL FK); user: userId to id (logical) (scalar-ID association; no declared FK); token owner: userId to id (logical) (scalar-ID association; no declared FK); requester: requesterId to User.id (scalar-ID association; no declared FK); recipient: recipientId to User.id; logical scalar IDs, no cross-service FK; blocker: blockerId to User.id (scalar-ID<br>association; no declared FK); blocked user: blockedUserId to User.id; logical scalar IDs, no cross-service FK; successor: replacedByTokenId: optional logical successor (scalar-ID association; no declared FK)" vertex="1" parent="1" Fragments use source predicates; ref expands a subordinate interaction.<br>Loop uses logical stop conditions equivalent to source for-loop plus break, not an idempotency key. Presign/upload failures skip the later steps inside explicit operands.<br>A server commit followed by lost HTTP response leaves no known reelCreated marker; another attempt generates a different random object key and new Reel/outbox IDs.<br>The storage SDK presigns locally; no fabricated Media-&gt;R2 presign network request. Logical RMQ RPC abstracts envelopes; presign and upload failure operands stop later steps.<br>Current mobile getReelUploadUrl sends fileType only; gateway purpose defaults to chat, so video key uses chat-videos rather than an assumed reels prefix. This is current source behavior, not an app change." vertex="1" parent="1" The ops reader validates/decode provenance and can reject incomplete or ambiguous records.<br>Rendering is parent-owned; fragment containment is recursive in this model, with no crossing XML coordinates supplied.<br>No retired RagTrace persistence is present in this focused workflow/ops path." vertex="1" parent="1" style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;overflow=hidden;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacing=2;fontSize=13;fontColor=#12263a;fillColor=#ffffff;;fontFamily=Arial;"><mxGeometry x="28" y="3383" width="1369" height="120" as="geometry" /></mxCell></root></mxGraphModel></diagram></mxfile>
